description.value: Squamish Canyon is an immersive nature attraction featuring elevated boardwalks through the UNESCO-designated Howe Sound Biosphere coastal rainforest, just off the Sea-to-Sky Highway. Visitors walk above the forest floor past Mamquam Falls through old-growth cedar and fir trees shaped by glacial and volcanic history going back 13,000 years. The on-site Forest Lounge Eatery offers beverages and light food in a moss-and-fern setting, and a nature play area caters to younger visitors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and active. The contact page confirms address (39180 Powerhouse Springs Rd.) and provides a phone number (778.605.3030) absent from OSM. The Forest Lounge Eatery is confirmed on site for food and beverages. No explicit mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM description tag states 'Officially opens August 1st,' which may be stale data from the initial season launch; the website appears to be in full operation with seasonal hours and no such restriction mentioned.
Phone number 778-605-3030 was sourced from the website; OSM has no phone field.
Boardwalk is confirmed not wheelchair accessible per FAQ page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, ticketed nature attraction on the Sea-to-Sky corridor with food on site; a touring cyclist riding that route would benefit from this listing, even though cycling-specific amenities are unconfirmed.

Café or food on site.detail: Forest Lounge Eatery on site; website describes it as 'a peaceful place to relax among moss and ferns, where you can enjoy a beverage and light eats.'

wow_evidence: New elevated-boardwalk attraction over Mamquam Falls in the Howe Sound Biosphere — polished 1–2 hour stop.
blurb: Elevated rainforest boardwalks over Mamquam Falls.
